description: Deposits are closed while Obento is paused, so this returns an error. Builds the two calls that deposit USDC into Obento for an address: approve the gateway, then deposit with a 0.5% minimum out and partner ID 2. The address signs and sends them in order on Base. Sends nothing itself.

address.description: The address that holds the USDC and receives the obUSD

amount.description: USDC to deposit, in dollars, such as "100" or "25.50"

title: Prepare a deposit
